_doc: Marketing capture camera presets (scripts/capture/capture_camera.gd, docs/CAPTURE.md). A spec frames a ground point: focus [x, z] in metres (y comes from the terrain, plus focus_h), the camera sits dist metres away at yaw_deg (0 = south of the focus looking north at the cliffs; positive turns the camera towards +x, the east) and pitch_deg above the horizon. fov in degrees, tilt_shift = the game's diorama depth of field, far = draw distance. A preset with no 'eras' entry frames the same view in every era (the matching before/after valley views); 'eras' overrides fields for one era. A move eases from one spec (or preset name) to another over 'duration' seconds; an orbit is a move that only turns the yaw.

valley_wide.label: The valley, wide (matching in every era)

village_close.label: The village, close (matching in every era)

fire_green.label: The fire and the green (matching in every era)

river.label: The river and the village behind it (matching in every era)

hero_low.label: Hero: a low angle across the village to the cliffs (matching in every era)

dolly_village.label: Slow dolly in over the village (20 s)

orbit_fire.label: Orbit round the fire (30 s, 120 degrees)

crane_reveal.label: Crane up from the hero angle to the whole valley (25 s)

spoiler._doc: SPOILER (--spoiler=goodbye): keys jump to a beat of the goodbye (its own cinematic camera), or pin a camera in the launch site's frame (pos and look are local to the pad: the tower on -x, the crowd's side +z).

evening.label: The last evening on the plateau

crew.label: The crew at the shrine stone

rocket.label: The rocket on the pad, the countdown

rocket_low.label: Hero: low under the rocket (pinned camera)

pad_wide.label: The pad and the crowd, wide (pinned camera)
